# Tensor products over an algebra generated by one element

Let `Z₀` and `V` be commutative rings with `V` a `Z₀`-algebra generated by a
single element `ϖ`, and let `A` and `C` be commutative `V`-algebras (with
compatible `Z₀`-algebra structures) and elements `μ ∈ A`, `w ∈ C` such that
`ϖ` maps to `1 - μ` in `A` and to `1 - w` in `C`. Then the quotient of `A
⊗[Z₀] C` by the ideal generated by `μ ⊗ 1 - 1 ⊗ w` is isomorphic as a ring
to `C ⊗[V] A`, by an isomorphism sending the class of `a ⊗ c` to `c ⊗ a`.
